transcript.answer: Conversations started surviving an api restart on 2026-09-30. Issue #296, "Persist support conversations through HAL Engine's MongoSessionStore", was opened that morning and closed at 10:25 UTC. It made the api's server.ts pass a MongoSessionStore to createHalEngine. Before that, the engine's in-memory default lost every conversation on restart. I took the date from the issue's closing time. I did not find the merged PR, so the exact merge time is unconfirmed. Issue #23 (closed 2026-09-23) had earlier closed on the premise that Otto would not build its own store, and the README now says conversations and escalations survive a restart.

judgements.reason: The answer gives the correct date 2026-09-30 and the essential mechanism (passing MongoSessionStore to the engine instead of the in-memory default), omitting only the commit hash and version, which is not contradicted.
